written_from_parent_concept.parent: google_compute_global_vm_extension_policy (rollout plans are real, but only documented as part of how global VM extension policies roll out changes)

intros.sourcing_notes: 71 of 95 resources map to their own real, specifically-documented concept page. 24 are real, narrower scopes of a documented parent -- almost entirely the region_*/zone_* pattern (a regional or zonal resource is, by Google's own documentation, explicitly the same real concept as its global counterpart, scoped narrower) -- sourced from that counterpart, not skipped. 0 genuine skips this provider. Real, verified finding: google_compute_rollout_plan initially looked like a possible skip (only a bare REST API listing turned up at first) -- a second, more targeted search found real explanatory content (rollout waves by zone/region for VM Extension Manager) before concluding it was undocumented, matching the ticket's own 'verified by looking, not assumed' bar. Several other resources (cross_site_network, wire_group, storage_pool, future_reservation, instance_group_manager_resize_request, global_vm_extension_policy, network_edge_security_service, region_composite_health_check/health_aggregation_policy/health_source, organization_security_policy) are genuinely recent GCP features verified live via WebSearch rather than assumed from general Compute Engine knowledge, the same discipline applied to Kubernetes's own newer APIs. No paid API used.

last_migration.phase: UBI-175 config-expansion phase A -- Discovery Doc config expansion + mechanical description mirror
last_migration.stopped_at: Config expanded: 128 new google_<api> dynamic_providers entries added (real Discovery Docs, live-verified), covering 656 new resource types / 48,455 real schema fields on top of the existing compute entry (95 resource types / 6,235 fields), confirmed via a real `ubx sdk gen --dump-ir` run (0 failures across all 416 configured dynamic providers). Phase A (this update): every field the schema itself already carries a real description for (21495 fields, 44% of the 48,455) mirrored into descriptions.json as source=docs-vendor -- 8344 of those belong to a resource type that already has a live page (google_lustre_instance etc, matched by wire name after correcting a real found-and-fixed naming defect: ubx-provider-dynamic's typeName synthesis doubles the API name when the config entry's own key duplicates the discovery doc's own doc.Name field, e.g. raw google_lustre_lustre_instance corrected to google_lustre_instance), 13151 belong to a resource type with no live page yet. Not yet done: the remaining 26960 fields (56%) need AI-authored description text (source=ai, no schema-native description exists), and all 656 new resource types need a real, live-researched intro (two-search minimum, matching the existing 95-resource compute batch's own methodology) -- both are separate, much larger, not-yet-started batches.
